'''No scar''' was the nickname of a bearded [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal who was a member of a group of mercenaries or pirates on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in [[3653 BBY]]. Alongside another criminal, nicknamed "[[Scar (criminal)|Scar]]," he tried to steal three cases of weapons from the [[Exchange]]'s agent and former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Zeerid Korr]]. Korr anticipated the ambush even after the group tried to trick him into thinking that they were sent by Arigo, and Korr attacked them first, killing No Scar with a well-placed strike to the throat. Korr managed to kill the entire criminal group before they could steal his weapons.
